author: pocketaces
text_post: How do I comfort my gf in this situation? This morning I got a text form my girlfriend saying she has to leave the city Saturday morning to goto the hospital because her aunt just had a stroke and might be blind. My response: 'Ohhh noooo babe.. I'm soo sorry to hear that .. If you need a ride up or anything, I would go with you' About 30 minutes later, she responds with: 'Well yeah now I'm pulled over and my license is apparently suspended and had no idea'. Talk about being shit on.. I have no idea how to even respond to this. Fuck, I feel terrible/helpless. ***Update*** Not long after that message, she said they wanted to arrest her. I said 'Whhaaat?? Over a suspended license?? Thats not right.. Call me the second you have a chance' I haven't heard back from her in almost 4 hours.. Wtf do I do?? I'm supposed to go out of town straight from work.. but I can't just leave without knowing what the hell is going on.
